name: appsleuth-runtime-agents
description: Build step for the Frida agents (Frida 17 no longer bundles the ObjC/Java bridges). Run: npm install && npm run build

scripts.build: frida-compile src/ios.js -o ../ios.js -c && frida-compile src/android.js -o ../android.js -c && frida-compile src/keychain.js -o ../keychain.js -c
